quota_reservations_consumed_ark_identity.name: quota_reservations_consumed_ark_identity_check
quota_reservations_consumed_ark_identity.value:
"quota_reservations"."status" <> 'consumed'
          or (
            length("quota_reservations"."ark_session_id") > 0
            and "quota_reservations"."ark_session_id" = btrim(
              "quota_reservations"."ark_session_id",
              concat(
                chr(9), chr(10), chr(11), chr(12), chr(13), chr(32),
                chr(160), chr(5760),
                chr(8192), chr(8193), chr(8194), chr(8195), chr(8196),
                chr(8197), chr(8198), chr(8199), chr(8200), chr(8201),
                chr(8202), chr(8232), chr(8233), chr(8239), chr(8287),
                chr(12288), chr(65279)
              )
            )
            and "quota_reservations"."ark_session_id" not like 'pending:%'
          )

sessions_exactly_one_agent_check.name: sessions_exactly_one_agent_check
sessions_exactly_one_agent_check.value:
(
        ("sessions"."agent_kind" = 'platform' and "sessions"."platform_agent_id" is not null and "sessions"."personal_agent_id" is null)
        or
        ("sessions"."agent_kind" = 'personal' and "sessions"."personal_agent_id" is not null and "sessions"."platform_agent_id" is null)
      )

usage_ledger_agent_attribution_check.name: usage_ledger_agent_attribution_check
usage_ledger_agent_attribution_check.value:
(
        "usage_ledger"."agent_kind" is null
        or ("usage_ledger"."agent_kind" = 'platform' and "usage_ledger"."platform_agent_id" is not null and "usage_ledger"."personal_agent_id" is null)
        or ("usage_ledger"."agent_kind" = 'personal' and "usage_ledger"."personal_agent_id" is not null and "usage_ledger"."platform_agent_id" is null)
      )
